title: Config keys
description: Every setting in honest_agent_config.yml.
---

<!-- Generated by site/scripts/generate_reference.py: edit that script, not this file. -->

`honest_agent_config.yml` holds a project's settings, with one target per agent. Any value can read an environment variable with `{{ env_var('NAME') }}` or `{{ env_var('NAME', 'default') }}`. Relative paths are relative to the file's folder. [Connect your agent](/docs/connect/) explains them with examples.

```yaml
results_path: ./honest_agent_results/results.duckdb
model: claude-sonnet-4-5            # top level: for every target
default_target: sales-agent

targets:
  sales-agent:
    mcp_url: "{{ env_var('SALES_AGENT_MCP_URL') }}"
    bearer_token_env: SALES_AGENT_MCP_TOKEN
    max_tool_steps: 8               # per target: only this one
```

## Top level only

| Setting | What it does |
|---|---|
| `default_target` | The target `run`, `debug`, `ls` and `notify` use without `--target`. |
| `results_path` | Where results are stored: a local DuckDB file (default `./honest_agent_results/results.duckdb`) or a MotherDuck database as `md:<name>`. To keep the file in cloud storage such as S3, copy it in and out around each run ([Storing results](/docs/storing-results/#in-cloud-storage)). Every target shares it, so one report covers every agent. |
| `targets` | One entry per agent you evaluate, by name. Each holds the target settings below. |

## Top level or per target

Set at the top level, a value applies to every target; a target's own value wins.

| Setting | What it does |
|---|---|
| `grading_model` | The model for grading: it pulls the value out for `extract_match` and judges the answer for `llm_judge` (`contains` uses none). Default: `model`. |
| `max_tool_steps` | Steps the agent may take per question; a step is one model call and the tool calls it asks for. Default: 5. |
| `model` | The model that plays the agent. Default: chosen from the API key you have. |

## Per target

| Setting | What it does |
|---|---|
| `agent_name` | The name results are recorded under. Default: the target's name. |
| `bearer_token_env` | The name of the variable that holds the server's bearer token, never the token. |
| `default_database` | The database where the server runs a bare table name, for provenance. |
| `default_schema` | The schema where the server runs a bare table name, for provenance. |
| `evals_dir` | The folder with this target's evals. Default: `evals`. |
| `ignore_tools` | Tools whose `sql`, `query` or `statement` argument isn't SQL, so provenance skips them. |
| `mcp_command` | The command that starts a local MCP server. Set this or `mcp_url`. |
| `mcp_env` | Variables from `.env` a local server needs. It gets only these, plus `PATH`, `HOME` and similar. |
| `mcp_url` | The URL of a remote MCP server. Set this or `mcp_command`. |
